title: Table Tennis Forehand Stroke Mediapipe Datasets
description:
Dataset Structure

1. Participants.xlsx

Contains characteristics for 34 provincial-level athletes.

2. Stroke_Data

Forehand stroke data for each participant.

● step1_track.xlsx: Raw 3D position data for 33 landmarks (captured via MediaPipe).

● step2_filtered.xlsx: Filtered position data.

● step3_segments_fly_hit.xlsx:

Labels each stroke's in/out frames in long-format data.

Marks the ball's (x, y) coordinates 6 frames before exiting the video frame.

Identifies the ball-racket impact frame.

3. Ball_Speed_Model

Dataset for training/evaluating the ball speed prediction model.
citation: Lyu (2025). Table Tennis Forehand Stroke Mediapipe Datasets. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.28881086.v2
